visualMaster.analysisSource: user-provided P01.png reviewed visually in ChatGPT
visualMaster.rule: Do not redesign P01 from text-only Rurubu rules. Reconstruct from this image first, then preserve editability.

coupleNames.forbidden: Do not invent, misspell, swap, translate, abbreviate, or OCR-correct these names without explicit user instruction.

weddingDate.forbidden: Do not change the year, month, day, separators, or infer another date from generated imagery.

visualAuthority.firstImpression: Bright, high-energy Japanese travel-magazine cover with unmistakable playful Rurubu-like editorial density rather than a generic wedding brochure.
readingOrder: three feature teasers on the left
bottom story statement and travel-stamp details

masthead.description: Large three-block るるぶ logo treatment near the top, each kana inside a chunky rounded colored block with thick white/black dimensional outline.
masthead.rule: Treat the masthead as display art, not ordinary Figma body text.

mainTitle.description: Extremely large hot-pink rounded display lettering spanning almost full width, with layered white/yellow/dark outlines and dimensional shadow.
mainTitle.rule: Do not reduce it to clean flat typography or a small centered heading.

backgroundSystem.description: Full-page bright tropical travel environment behind the editorial objects: vivid blue sky, soft clouds, chapel/beach-resort cues and palm/tropical destination atmosphere. The background carries the travel-destination identity before smaller stickers are added.
backgroundSystem.pageField: Warm pale-yellow outer page field visible beyond the inner airmail frame.
backgroundSystem.innerEnvironment: Sky-blue destination scene fills the inner page and remains visually active behind the title, portrait and feature callouts.
backgroundSystem.rule: Do not replace the visual-master background with a flat color, generic gradient, plain white canvas, or rely on the hero photograph alone to provide all environmental personality. Prepare/generate the background as its own production art when needed so it can be composed independently in Figma.

outerPageFrame.description: Continuous diagonal airmail stripe border in blue, pink, yellow and white around the inner page, with a clean white inner separation edge.
outerPageFrame.rule: This is part of the page identity, not an optional decoration. Rebuild as prepared/generated frame art rather than a generic Figma stroke.

heroPhotoTreatment.description: The large central couple image is integrated into the destination scene with editorial overlap rather than placed inside a generic rounded card.
heroPhotoTreatment.rule: Do not add a uniform rounded rectangle around the hero. Preserve the open magazine-cover integration and title/photo overlap.

featurePhotoFrames.description: Three small left-side feature thumbnails use simple white print/photo borders with slight editorial irregularity and are attached to numbered feature callouts.
featurePhotoFrames.rule: Each thumbnail/frame is subordinate, replaceable and independently positionable. Avoid identical app-card shells, excessive corner radius or perfectly uniform spacing.

frameSystem.rule: Frames, vessels and backings that carry the Rurubu visual language should be prepared/generated as page-specific art where plain Figma geometry would weaken the reference.

photoHierarchy.hero: One dominant portrait-oriented couple photo occupies most of the center/lower page and remains visually stronger than all support imagery.
photoHierarchy.support: Small feature thumbnails are secondary and embedded in editorial callouts rather than equal-sized cards.
photoHierarchy.rule: Keep strongly unequal photo hierarchy; avoid equal grids and generic card layouts.

composition.density: High but organized; many elements overlap and touch without becoming a uniform grid.
composition.alignment: Intentional asymmetry with dominant centered title/photo structure and offset editorial objects around it.
composition.edgeBehavior: Decorative flowers, leaves, stamps and title shapes actively use page edges and overlap neighboring areas.
composition.rule: Preserve purposeful collisions and irregular editorial clustering. Do not normalize into evenly spaced modules.

travelEditorialGrammar: date shown on a ticket/postcard-like paper object
airplane icon and dotted travel path

colorBehavior.rule: Use saturated travel-magazine color blocking with white separation and dark outlines; avoid luxury-beige minimalism or generic gradients.

typographyBehavior.display: Very heavy rounded outlined display lettering with depth and playful irregularity.
typographyBehavior.secondary: Handwritten/script and bold Japanese feature headings used selectively.
typographyBehavior.body: Small factual labels remain readable and subordinate.
typographyBehavior.rule: Hierarchy must come from scale, weight, outline, overlap and placement before decoration.

imageGeneratedOrPreparedArt: flowers, foliage, airplane/path and destination illustrations
nativeEditableText: feature headings and factual copy where editability is required
editableReconstructionPolicy.rule: Figma is the compositor. Rebuild the reference appearance with independent background/frame art, layered replaceable photography and native factual copy rather than flattening the full page as the editable master.

hardRejects: flat or generic background replacing the destination environment
generic Figma stroke substituted for page-specific frame art
flat native-text substitute for the expressive masthead
clean centered template with excessive empty space
generated text treated as authoritative factual copy

qa.gate0: At a 3-second glance, the page must read as a playful Japanese travel-magazine wedding cover, not merely as a colorful wedding collage.
qa.referenceDelta: Any production rebuild must be compared directly against P01.png for background atmosphere, airmail frame, masthead strength, title scale, hero dominance, feature-frame behavior, density, edge activity, travel motifs and color energy before technical QA.
technicalQaAfterVisualPass: background is independent and not accidentally baked into replaceable photography unless explicitly approved
outer frame integrity and bleed behavior
